decisions.reason: The same message's separate header instruction is already fully represented by the candidate's MODIFY for RR02, RR03, and RR04; the footer-code Event requires no additional candidate change.
The page-one report-detail identifiers are separate from footer codes and are already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Correcting footer codes does not change the variant count, variant IDs, selection basis, or exposure-level mapping.
The footer-code corrections do not alter the candidate's page-two risk-appropriate wording.
Footer identifiers do not change the dashboard's fields, prominence, heading, visibility, or visual reference.
The specific footer-code correction leaves the broader visual-quality and cross-variant design requirements unchanged.
The generic footer Requirement already requires a report ID on every page; variant-specific identifier values are independently owned by the footer-code consistency Requirement.
Correcting footer codes does not change the warning's presence, message, visual treatment, or relationship to the footer.
The generic internal-header structure remains unchanged, while variant-specific header codes are already represented by the separate internal-header code Requirement.
The footer-code corrections do not alter which customer fields are editable or the assessment-date field behavior.
Footer identifiers are unrelated to the content and scannability of the front-page result explanation.
The footer-code correction does not affect the inclusion, ranking, tiers, or presentation of recommended security actions.
